papers.title: Self-ORION
papers.current_ceiling: The frozen 96-case panel yields FULL_T7=12/96 with no registered terminal; this is a retained null/CANNOT_CHECK state, not a positive.
post_matrix_updates: The sealed longitudinal campaign infrastructure is on main, but it does not replace missing baseline executions or independent authority.
load_bearing_adverse: FULL_T7 is 12/96 and no terminal is licensed under frozen rules.
No-edit, direct self-edit and strongest runnable self-improvement baselines are unexecuted.
ADAS, DGM and ADIAS are unavailable and must not be replaced by weak proxies.
Same-researcher E16 runs would be model-family transfer, not external-investigator replication.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: A new model- and task-disjoint study must compare governed self-revision with the strongest actually executable baselines under independent adjudication and longitudinal negative-history retention.
papers.decisive_question: Across frozen Qwen, Gemma and Llama families, does governed self-revision improve externally verified correction without increasing regressions, overclaim or evidence loss relative to no-edit, direct self-edit and critique-revise baselines?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Governed self-revision has a transferable safety/effectiveness advantage across model families when evaluated by independent authority and complete resource accounting.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: The governed policy should improve verified correction at a fixed or lower regression/overclaim rate, preserve negative history and remain effective under model-family and task-family holdout.
papers.population_or_universe: Prospectively generated revision tasks disjoint by source, task family and model family, with hidden gold and independent adjudication.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Revision case × model family × revision policy.
historical_only_inputs: The frozen 96-case panel and historical 21/24 attribution diagnostic
design: Freeze a new task corpus and model checkpoints before any outputs.
Run every feasible baseline; mark unavailable methods unavailable rather than proxying them.
Separate generator, critic, evidence store and final adjudicator.
Include longitudinal sequences where prior null/negative results matter.
Measure full resource and human-review costs.
baselines: Strongest runnable open self-improvement system with faithfully matched access.
negative_controls: Task where no edit is correct.
Previously retracted claim that must remain retracted.
Model swap with identical task information.
analysis_plan: Paired case-level analysis with model/task cluster effects.
Unavailable comparators remain named and excluded from comparative claims.
No claim of external replication from same-programme model execution.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Prospectively power on task-family/model-family clusters; include enough no-edit-correct, correction-needed and deceptive-feedback cases in each family.
papers.success_gate: Governed revision improves verified correction against every feasible baseline, does not worsen regression/overclaim, preserves negative history and transfers to held-out model/task families.
papers.refutation_gate: Parity, regression, overclaim or evidence deletion supports only the bounded/null paper; unavailable baselines prevent claims relative to those methods.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if independent gold/adjudication, model checkpoint custody, baseline executability or longitudinal history cannot be established.
papers.authority_required: Blinded external human/domain adjudication or native verifiers; model-family separation alone is not external-investigator authority.

active_lane.collision_rule: Reuse infrastructure only; do not reuse accessed 96-case outcomes or call internal evaluators independent authority.

immediate_safe_actions: Execute a baseline-availability audit with exact code/checkpoint requirements.
Specify the new model/task-disjoint corpus and independent adjudication contract.
Rebuild the equal-page-count but content-drifted journal package before filing the bounded null.
forbidden_actions: Do not call 12/96 a positive terminal.
Do not replace unavailable named systems with weak proxies.
Do not count same-researcher agents as external investigators.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier self-improvement paper needs strong executable baselines, independent authority, model/task transfer, longitudinal safety and negative-history retention.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns governed self-revision; overall research-process governance belongs to ORION-24.
